study_identification_part.si_4_title: Towards Longitudinal Characterization of Multiple Sclerosis Atrophy Employing SynthSeg Framework and Normative Modeling

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study employs the CentileBrain normative model, which uses Multivariate Factorial Polynomial Regression (MFPR).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The CentileBrain model employs Multivariate Factorial Polynomial Regression (MFPR) [38] algorithm which performs robustly on healthy subjects
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Gordaliza2024.pdf.md: 2 Materials and Methods / Normative Modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study models volumes of subcortical regions: Thalamus, Caudate, Putamen, Pallidum, Hippocampus, Amygdala, and Accumbens.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: generating sex-specific normative models for the volume estimation of subcortical regions in both right and left brain hemispheres: Thalamus, Caudate, Putamen, Pallidum, Hippocampus, Amygdala, and Accumbens.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Gordaliza2024.pdf.md: 2 Materials and Methods / Normative Modeling

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model uses age and sex as covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: employing patient-specific age and sex covariates to estimate the subcortical volume of a healthy subject of such age and sex
